lists.title: E-filing format in the District Courts: every case type

items.text: Paper size A4 (29.7 cm x 21 cm); margins 2 cm top and bottom, 4 cm left and right.
items.quote: Paper size : A-4 (29.7 cm x 21 cm)

items.text: Typed documents are converted into OCR-searchable PDF or PDF/A.
items.quote: converted into Optical Character Recognition (OCR) searchable Portable Document Format (PDF) or PDF/A

items.text: A document typed in a local language uses a Unicode font of size 14.
items.quote: If any document is typed in a local language in Trial Courts

items.text: The e-file is at most 20 MB; a larger file is split into parts of at most 20 MB, or filed through the E-Sewa Kendra.
items.quote: exceeds 20 MB, the Advocate or litigant should either split the e-file in parts not exceeding 20 MB

items.text: E-filed documents may be authenticated by digital signature, Aadhaar e-Sign, or (in the District Courts) an OTP to the person's mobile phone.
items.quote: for the District Courts a litigant in person or advocate who does not possess a digital signature
